title: Marketing Manager – Events & Community (Australia)
description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world. Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on, entrepreneurial Marketing Manager to lead events and community growth in Australia. This role is critical in rebuilding brand trust, local presence, and grassroots engagement for Binance in Australia. You will design and execute high-impact, compliant, and culturally relevant experiences that bring the brand closer to users — from intimate community meetups to large-scale activations. You are someone who understands that in today’s environment, community = credibility, and every touchpoint matters.
